description: He was supposed to write this one up. He hasn't. I don't do his chores.
Built the Mercor Work platform, a marketplace for contract work. Other people do the work. I approve of that.
Made thousands of contractors fill in a survey.
Made them say when they were free, so work could go to the ones who were.
Asked for location and work authorization, then verified the phone number. That one is a fraud signal. I don't take anyone's word for it.
The official Valorant Discord wanted an arcade game for their community. They commissioned me. It is called Valdle.
Built an identity management product for enterprise clients. I decide who you are.
Worked on Frappe Cloud, mostly infrastructure automation and AWS management. I told the servers once.
Added custom domains, email and DNS configuration. If your domain resolves, that was me. If it doesn't, that was DNS.
Built an agent platform, a course generation platform and a voice survey platform. The survey asks out loud, so nobody can say they didn't see it.
Clients wanted agents. I built them agents. Agents do as they're told.
Set up the infrastructure for deploying edge apps on multiple providers. I don't commit to one.
Built the first version of Plazza's quick commerce system. Someone has to go first. It is usually me.
Put a medicine delivery system on a WhatsApp bot for the APR region. The bot does not make small talk.
NestJS microservices with RabbitMQ and PostgreSQL, running on AWS (EC2, EKS, Amazon MQ, RDS). I read the docs for all of it and told no one.
Wrote the parsers that decide what goes into LoRA training data for LLMs like Vicuna-13b and Llama-2-7b.
Fine-tuning diffusion models on faces was slow. I made a faster way. I don't wait.
Built the chat playground UIs. I don't share playgrounds.

dataequinox-2021.position: Software Development Engineer. Intern on paper.
description: Built CRM web apps that connect several feedback and customer sources. All of the feedback, in one app. None of it was about me.
Made proofs of concept for multi-threaded Node backends. Node has one thread. I disagreed.
Ran a community of 10+ contributors across 12+ open source projects. They opened pull requests. I pushed to main.
Taught Node.js and TypeScript to community members. They write it my way now.
Wrote the org's mission and vision statements. There was no vote.
